recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast composition featuring a central sepia-toned Victorian-style painting of a woman flanked by two cherubs, framed by a thin red double-line border on a solid black background. The lower third is dominated by vibrant, cyan-blue psychedelic bubble lettering with white outlines and heavy drop shadows.
coreVisualRelationships: Juxtaposition of classical fine art with 1960s pop-psychedelia
Warm sepia tones of the central image against a stark black void
Vibrant cyan text acting as a modern visual anchor over traditional imagery
Thin geometric red framing containing the organic forms of the painting
coreInvariants: Cyan-blue bubble lettering with white highlights
Thin red rectangular border with cross-hair corners

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The central figure is vertically centered, occupying approximately 70% of the frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large cyan bubble lettering at the bottom center serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the vibrant blue text, move up to the woman's face, then out to the cherubs and the red border.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounds the central framed artwork, creating a 'window' effect.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the desaturated, mid-tone illustration and the highly saturated, bright cyan text.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely tight kerning with overlapping characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'L' and 'A' feature elongated, wavy tails
Ascenders and descenders are shortened to maintain a compact block shape
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Modernist sans-serif for metadata against custom liquid lettering for the main title.
graphicDevices: Circular logo badge integrated into text

avoid: High-contrast serifs for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 60s psychedelic weight and roundness
Similar lack of descenders and rounded friendly feel

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a sepia-toned Victorian painting of a seated woman with two winged cherubs in a garden. Place this inside a thin red double-line rectangular frame with cross-hair corners. Set the entire framed image against a solid black background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, cyan-blue psychedelic bubble lettering with a white outline and dark blue drop shadow over the bottom third of the illustration. Use a stacked, slightly arched layout for the text.

verificationChecks: Is the central image strictly sepia-toned?
Does the text have a vibrant cyan fill with a white outline?
Are the red border lines thin and precise?

adjustableVariables: Thickness of the red border lines
Amount of overlap between text and illustration
mustRedesign: Specific faces of the woman and cherubs
Any existing brand logos or specific record label text
Exact wording of the original title

mustAchieve: High-impact color contrast between cyan and sepia
Clean, sharp execution of the outer black border
avoid: Modern digital gradients in the illustration
Thin, spindly fonts for the main title
Blurry edges on the red frame

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the cherubs' wings are visible and sepia-toned.
Check that the red border lines intersect at the corners correctly.
Verify the cyan text is legible despite its liquid distortion.
Confirm the black background is uniform and matte.
recipe.reuseFormula: Victorian Sepia Illustration + Black Negative Space Frame + Cyan Psychedelic Bubble Type = 1960s Retro-Classical Aesthetic
